from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; x=df['x'].values; v=df['v'].values; y=df['dv_dt'].values
def base(p):
    return p[0]*x**1.5 + p[1]*(x/(1+p[2]*x))*v
best=None
for s in [0.1,0.5,1,2]:
    q=least_squares(lambda p: base(p)-y,[s,s,s])
    if best is None or q.cost<best.cost: best=q
p0=best.x
bestw=None
for w in np.linspace(0.2,3,2801):
    B=np.c_[np.cos(w*t),np.sin(w*t),x*np.cos(w*t),x*np.sin(w*t),v*np.cos(w*t),v*np.sin(w*t),x*v*np.cos(w*t),x*v*np.sin(w*t)]
    r=y-base(p0)
    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,r,rcond=None)
    e=np.var(r-B@c)
    if bestw is None or e<bestw[0]: bestw=(e,w,c)
print(p0, bestw[1], bestw[0]/np.var(y)); print(bestw[2].round(3))
